brief: Whimsical, paper-cut ships traverse a translucent, aqueous medium. As they drift and sail, they continuously leave behind dissolving wake trails composed of crystalline salt deposits. These trails are permanent, gradually solidifying into brittle mineral scaffolds. Simultaneously, the edges of the vessels detach, drifting into accumulated piles and eventually forming dense, mountainous drifts along the sheet’s periphery. This mineral and detrital buildup eventually encases and solidifies the hulls of the paper ships, turning the transient scene into a permanent, mineralized tableau.

lineage.critique: the same translucent medium populated by whimsical, paper-cut ships, and this time the accumulated mineral sediment begins to encase and solidify the hulls of the ships.

statement: This sketch depicts a surreal aquatic scene where whimsical paper ships drift through a translucent, aqueous medium. As they sail, each vessel leaves behind dissolving wake trails composed of crystalline salt deposits that gradually solidify into brittle mineral scaffolds. The most significant evolution from the original is the introduction of hull encasement—when ships decay sufficiently, their hulls become permanently encased in mineral formations, transforming the transient scene into a permanent, mineralized tableau. The interplay between the fragile paper vessels and the accumulating sediment creates an evolving landscape where the ephemeral becomes eternal.
